Senses.Explanation: The conventional count of the inherited old cases, invoked as one bulk body to be dismissed, melted, or settled at a stroke. Zhongfeng Mingben rates even a thousand vines of the seventeen hundred worth less than one laugh as they melt, Liangting Jingting's opening instruction declares the whole store, the seventeen hundred cases, and every old monk's tongue to be lies that yet do not lie, Yushan Shangsi's evening verse credits the store with flowing east while the seventeen hundred shake the western dryness, and Jinian Jingxian's small-assembly verse presses the seventeen hundred into an iron wall until it breaks open into good news. Yuan'an Liao sets his Shending furnace to melt the seventeen hundred rotten vines and five thousand worn scrolls at once with nothing leaking through, Xueyan Zuqin sweeps the seventeen hundred exchanges of host-and-guest and the whole store into one bulk and calls them fox spit, Feiyin Tongrong names the seventeen hundred as worn straw sandals that dull his descendants while he teases Zhaozhou's old footnote, and Tianru Weize strings the seventeen hundred ancestral moves with the treasury and the subtle heart and tosses the string aside to walk the road the buddha never walked.
